stop it! phrase

also cut it out, lay off!, lay off, cut that out right now

classical

Traupman 96
Traupman 33: cut it out, dēsine (dēsinite); dēsiste (dēsistite)
Traupman 300: dēsinās! (pl. dēsinātis!)
Traupman 338

Dēsine!

Wiktionary

Other words

  • Dēsiste!

    also used · classical · Traupman 96; Traupman 300 · Wiktionary

  • Supersedē istīs rēbus! — cut that out!, give that up!

    also used · classical · Plaut. Ep. 1.1.37: istīs rēbus (Lewis & Short s.v. supersedeō: “to refrain or desist from”, with the ablative); Traupman 300

    (vōx cōmica: Plaut.)

Examples

  • Dēsine tandem!

    Lay off!Traupman 102

  • Supersedē istīs rēbus jam.

    Cut that out right now.Traupman 96

See also stop squabbling!, leave me alone!, stop talking.
